list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A neutral assembly containing four Ho centers, two Li ions, six imino-functionalized indolyl ligands, and four bridging chlorides. The indolyl ligands include a carbon-bound indolyl-1,2-dianion.

synthesis.procedure: Under the dry-argon conditions stated for the experimental section, a toluene solution of the holmium bis(trimethylsilyl)amide precursor was added to 3-(tert-butylimino)indole in toluene at room temperature. The mixture was refluxed for 12 h.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature during addition; reflux; 0 °C for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent evaporated under reduced pressure; product extracted with n-hexane and crystallized at 0 °C.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The erbium analogue of 1a is a neutral assembly of four Er centers, two Li ions, six imino-functionalized indolyl ligands, and four bridging chlorides.

synthesis.procedure: The erbium precursor and 3-(tert-butylimino)indole were reacted by the procedure reported for 1a: addition in toluene, 12 h reflux, removal of solvent, n-hexane extraction, and crystallization at 0 °C under the stated dry-argon conditions.

source_locations.location: Discussion on Structure Data; Figure 2 and Table 2
Experimental Section, synthesis of 2a

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A centrosymmetric dimer of tridentate indolyl-supported yttrium units with lithium ions linked to yttrium through bridging chloride. Each five-coordinate Y center has a distorted trigonal-bipyramidal environment comprising the tridentate ligand, THF, and chloride.

synthesis.procedure: Under the stated dry-argon conditions, the yttrium amide precursor in toluene was added to 3-(phenylimino)indole in toluene at room temperature, then stirred at reflux for 12 h.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature during addition; reflux; 0 °C for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed under reduced pressure; extracted with an n-hexane/THF mixture and crystallized at 0 °C.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The isostructural samarium analogue of 2a forms a centrosymmetric, chloride-bridged dimer containing two Sm and two Li ions. Each Sm center is five-coordinate with a tridentate indolyl ligand and THF.

synthesis.procedure: The samarium precursor and 3-(phenylimino)indole were reacted under the dry-argon, refluxing-toluene procedure reported for 2a.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Following 2a, the residue was extracted with n-hexane/THF and crystallized; yellow rectangular crystals were isolated.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A centrosymmetric hexanuclear Dy complex. Each four-coordinate Dy center binds nitrogen donors from an indolyl unit, an aniline group, an N(SiMe3) species, and an N(CH2SiMe2)(SiMe3) species.

synthesis.procedure: Under the stated dry-argon conditions, a toluene solution of the dysprosium amide precursor was added at room temperature to 3-(4-tert-butylphenylimino)indole in toluene. The mixture was refluxed for 12 h.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature during addition; reflux; room temperature for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed under reduced pressure; product extracted with n-hexane and crystallized at room temperature.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A heterometallic assembly with six Y and six Li centers. Unlike the 5-series, its anilido group is coordinated to both a yttrium ion and a lithium ion; each Y center has four nitrogen donors.

synthesis.procedure: The yttrium precursor and 3-(4-tert-butylphenylimino)indole were reacted under the stated dry-argon conditions by a procedure similar to that for 5a, except that the toluene mixture was refluxed for 3 h.
synthesis.time: 3 h reflux; several days crystallization by the referenced procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Following 5a, solvent was removed and the product extracted with n-hexane; white crystals were isolated.
